[[Erulai the Inimical]] can be found on the [[Bloodstone]] during the [[mini-mission]] part of the [[All for One and One for Justice]] [[quest]].  He was once a friend of [[Olias]], before Olias realized the truth of things and left.

== Locations ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Bloodstone Fen|explorable area}}

== Skills ==
15 [[Blood Magic]] (20 Blood Magic in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}
* {{skill icon|Shadow Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Unholy Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Well of the Profane}}

== Notes ==
* He becomes an ally when defeated, and then hostile again as the Torment creatures appear and attack him.
